text:
🏗️ NEED MORE SPACE? WE’VE GOT YOU COVERED! 🏗️

At Scotia Steel Construction, we don’t just build buildings — we build solutions.

With 16 years of experience as a family-run business, we’ve been proudly supplying and constructing quality steel buildings across the UK 🇬🇧

From Scotland all the way down to Dover, our team travels nationwide to deliver strong, reliable and professional builds you can count on.

Whether you’re:
✅ Expanding your business
✅ Adding extra storage space
✅ Looking for a new workshop
✅ Building a garage at home
✅ Starting a brand-new project

Whatever your vision — we can make it happen.

📩 Get in touch today for your FREE quote and let’s start planning your next build!

Scotia Steel Construction — Built to last.

text:
🏗️ Building Excellence for Over 16 Years 🏗️

At Scotia Steel Construction, we take pride in delivering high-quality steel buildings across the UK for more than 16 years. Our experience, craftsmanship, and commitment to excellence have made us one of the leading names in steel construction throughout Scotland and beyond.

From industrial units and agricultural buildings to bespoke steel structures, we provide reliable solutions tailored to your needs — wherever you are in the UK.

✅ Trusted Experience
✅ Quality Workmanship
✅ Nationwide Coverage
✅ Professional Service

📞 Request your FREE quote today and let Scotia Steel Construction bring your project to life

🎆 Happy New Year 2026 from Scotia Steel! 🎆

Thank you to all our customers for your support and trust over the past year. We’re proud to deliver strong, reliable steel buildings that stand the test of time.

Here’s to a successful 2026 filled with:
🏗️ New projects
🔩 Quality builds
🚀 Continued growth

If 2026 is the year you’re planning an industrial or commercial steel building, we’d love to help.

📞 Get in touch:
📱 07799 170792
📱 07798 908238

🥂 Happy New Year from everyone at Scotia Steel!

Free lance / self employment job opportunities  

Looking for experienced steel erector  in working with steel buildings and cladding Mainly specialising cold rolled steel structures with the occasional hot rolled structures 

MUST HAVE :

Driving licence 
Site cards 
Cscs 
IPAF card etc 

Work would be on job to job basis as we have occasional dry patches between jobs Looking for team leader roll Individual must be good at Time keeping 
Keeping file and paper work in order

Committed to the job role for providing the best customer service our company thrives to achieve All our jobs are mainly based in Scotland and Northern England but can be nationalised travel across the uk Day salary rate , with the opportunity to achieve bonuses. 

If you are interested please call Christian on 07799170792 or via email scotiasteel@outlook.com

Welcome to scotia steel. Where we provided over 15 years of experience in supplying and constructing steel buildings. We specialise in cold rolled steel framed buildings. Scotia supply steel framed buildings for many applications, due to our diverse back room software the quotation of steel buildings large or small is made swift and easy. Our steel frames are assembled using high yield strength
cold rolled profiles. Cold rolled profiles tend to have a better strength to weight ratio than alternative steel building construction methods, resulting in the cold rolled building being a great cost effective solution. Scotia steel can also be manufactured and delivered to site
in 4-6 working weeks from receipt of order / final approval of building size colour etc. We aim to reply to all quotation request within a 24hr period.
